evidence.quote: All courses are taught in English; therefore, a B2 level English proficiency is required.
Costs: The tuition fee for this program is 7,500 USD/Year

notes: The language certificate is not strictly required because applicants may be exempted or assessed at the entrance interview, so the requirement is a manual check for the admission office.

evidence.quote: Applicants must have an English proficiency of at least B2 level as the program is fully taught in English.
a TOEFL test with a minimum score of 513 (Paper-Based).
an IELTS test with a minimum score of 5.5.
Please note, that you are not strictly required to have a language exam certificate, your language skills will be assessed during the entrance interview.

note.fr: Un examen d'entrée en mathématiques et en physique est obligatoire. Les résultats supérieurs ou égaux à 75 % donnent l'admission ; entre 60 % et 75 %, l'admission se fait en programme préparatoire.
note.en: An entrance exam in Mathematics and Physics is compulsory. Results of 75% and over mean admission; results between 60%-75% mean admission to a preparatory (foundation year) programme.

evidence.quote: Results about 75% and over mean admission to the selected programme, results between 60%-75% -admission to a preparatory (foundation year) programme.

note.fr: Pour les programmes non médicaux de premier cycle, l'interruption des études ne peut pas dépasser 4 ans.
note.en: For non-medical applicants to foundation or undergraduate programs, the study gap cannot be longer than 4 years.

evidence.quote: In case of non-medical applicants to foundation or undergraduate programs, the study gap cannot be longer than 4 years.
